# Lab4PKG

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/kanneb/Lab4PKG/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kanneb/Lab4PKG/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

Lab4PKG fits a linear regression model using ordinary least squares.
You create the model with `linreg()` and then use its methods to look at the result.

This package also includes the bonus lab, which implements ridge regression
with `ridgereg()`.

## Installation

Install from GitHub. Set the option first if you also want the vignette:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
options(pkg.build_vignettes = TRUE)
pak::pak("kanneb/Lab4PKG")
```

## Example

```{r example}
library(Lab4PKG)

estimation <- linreg(Petal.Length ~ Species, data = iris)
estimation$print()
```

Other methods: `plot()`, `resid()`, `pred()`, `coef()` and `summary()`.

### Ridge regression

```{r ridge-example}
ridge <- ridgereg$new(Petal.Length ~ Species, data = iris, lambda = 1)
ridge$coef()
head(ridge$predict())
```

## More

The package has three vignettes:

- **Lab4PKG_vignette**: explains every method of `linreg()` with examples.
- **ridgereg**: shows how to use `ridgereg()`.
- **flight_delay**: predicts flight delays from weather data with `ridgereg()`.

Open them with:

``` r
browseVignettes("Lab4PKG")
```
